usage: The ONS provisional estimate of the UK population, entered by hand from the bulletin named in source. One figure for the whole UK: ONS publishes no breakdown by council, age or sex. Replace the whole file when ONS publishes the next edition; do not edit single values.

source.title: Provisional population estimate for the UK: mid-2026
source.sections: sections 1 (Main points) and 2 (Data sources and quality)
source.replacedBy: ONS aims to publish mid-2026 population estimates, including local authorities by single year of age and sex, in summer 2027.

rounding: ONS gives each figure in the bulletin to the nearest thousand.

previous.statedIn: The same bulletin, section 2, as the base for the provisional estimate.

checks.arithmetic: 69,484,000 plus 646,000 births, less 643,000 deaths, plus 77,000 net international migration, gives 69,564,000.
checks.migration: The same net migration figure, 77,000 for the year ending June 2026, is in ONS, Long-term international migration, provisional: year ending June 2026, section 1, released 26 November 2026.
checks.previous: The mid-2025 bulletin's country table gives the UK as 69,483,900 and its revisions section rounds it to 69,484,000.
